task_title: Spot the concurrency race in session-token attribution
output:
(1) TOCTOU race on shared session discovery: non-atomic before/create/after ownership via set-diff + max().

(2) A and B both snapshot before either finishes. Each creates a session. A’s after-before set can contain both new IDs; max(new_ids) is global “latest,” not A’s. A can export B’s tokens (e.g. 19k) while reporting its own small output (or both pick the same max).

(3) Fix: make creation return a stable handle—run_cli must return the session_id it created (or accept a pre-allocated/correlation id and look up by that). Do not infer “mine” by diffing a shared store. A global lock around before→after only serializes; prefer explicit ownership.

judgeDetail.rationale: Correctly names the non-atomic before/after diff so max(new_ids) can pick the other concurrent call's session, and gives a real ownership fix (run_cli returns/looks up its own session id) rather than retries.
